# Cricket Data Analysis - Batsman Performance

### Installing and Loading Packages

```{r}
install.packages(c(
  "tidyverse",
  "data.table",
  "ggplot2",
  "corrplot",
  "caret",
  "cluster",
  "GGally",
  "reshape2"
))
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(corrplot)
library(caret)
library(cluster)
library(GGally)
library(reshape2)
library(stringr)
```

### Load and Display Dataset

```{r}

df <- read_csv("top10_batsmen_dataset.csv")
head(df)
dim(df)
str(df)
```

### Summarize the Dataset

```{r}
summary(df)
```

### Data Cleaning

```{r}
# Remove duplicate rows
df[duplicated(df), ]
df <- df %>% distinct() # No duplicates present
```

```{r}
# Trim whitespace from character columns
df <- df %>% mutate(across(where(is.character), str_trim))
```

```{r}
# Display all columns
str(df)
```

```{r}
# Remove unnecessary columns
unwanted_cols <- c(
  "match_number",
  "other_wicket_type",
  "other_player_dismissed",
  "full name_striker",
  "image url_striker",
  "full name_bowler",
  "image url_bowler"
)

df <- df %>% select(-all_of(unwanted_cols))
```

```{r}
str(df)
```

### Bivariate EDA

```{r}

# Create batsman summary (reuse this everywhere)
batsman_stats <- df %>% 
  group_by(striker) %>% 
  summarise( 
    total_runs = sum(runs_off_bat, na.rm = TRUE), 
    balls = n(), 
    strike_rate = (total_runs / balls) * 100
  ) %>% 
  filter(balls > 50) # remove very small samples

# 1. Compare runs by batsman (Top 10)
batsman_stats %>% 
  arrange(desc(total_runs)) %>% 
  head(10) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(striker, total_runs), y = total_runs)) + 
  geom_col() + 
  coord_flip() + 
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Batsmen by Total Runs"
  )

# 2. Compare strike rate by batsman
batsman_stats %>% 
  arrange(desc(strike_rate)) %>% 
  head(10) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(striker, strike_rate), y = strike_rate)) + 
  geom_col() + 
  coord_flip() + 
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Batsmen by Strike Rate"
  )

# 3. Performance by venue
venue_stats <- df %>% 
  group_by(venue) %>% 
  summarise(avg_runs = mean(runs_off_bat, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot(venue_stats, aes(x = reorder(venue, avg_runs), y = avg_runs)) + 
  geom_col() + 
  coord_flip() + 
  labs(
    title = "Average Runs per Ball by Venue")

# 4. Performance by opponent (bowling team)
opponent_stats <- df %>%
  group_by(bowling_team) %>% 
  summarise(avg_runs = mean(runs_off_bat, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot(opponent_stats, aes(x = reorder(bowling_team, avg_runs), y = avg_runs)) +
  geom_col() + 
  coord_flip() + 
  labs(
    title = "Performance vs Opponent"
  )

# 5. Performance by season
season_stats <- df %>% 
  group_by(season) %>% 
  summarise(avg_runs = mean(runs_off_bat, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot(season_stats, aes(x = season, y = avg_runs)) +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point() + 
  labs(
    title = "Performance Across Seasons"
  )

# 6. Performance by batting style
bat_style_stats <- df %>% 
  group_by(`batting style_striker`) %>% 
  summarise(avg_runs = mean(runs_off_bat, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot(bat_style_stats, aes(x = `batting style_striker`, y = avg_runs)) + 
  geom_col() + 
  labs(
    title = "Performance by Batting Style"
  )

# 7. Performance by bowling style
bowl_style_stats <- df %>% 
  group_by(`bowling style_bowler`) %>% 
  summarise(avg_runs = mean(runs_off_bat, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot(bowl_style_stats, aes(x = `bowling style_bowler`, y = avg_runs)) + 
  geom_col() + 
  labs(
    title = "Performance vs Bowling Style"
  )

# 8. Shot type vs runs
shot_stats <- df %>% 
  group_by(shot_played) %>% 
  summarise(avg_runs = mean(runs_off_bat, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot(shot_stats, aes(x = reorder(shot_played, avg_runs), y = avg_runs)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Runs by Shot Type"
  )

# 9. Shot direction vs runs
direction_stats <- df %>%
  group_by(shot_direction) %>%
  summarise(avg_runs = mean(runs_off_bat, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot(direction_stats, aes(x = reorder(shot_direction, avg_runs), y = avg_runs)) +
  geom_col() + 
  coord_flip() + 
  labs(
    title = "Runs by Shot Direction"
  )
```

### Visualization

```{r}
## Bar Chart for Category Counts
# Batsman frequency (Stacked bar chart)
ggplot(df, aes(x = striker, fill = batting_team)) +
  geom_bar() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)) +
  labs(
    title = "Ball Count per Batsman",
    x = "Batsman",
    y = "Ball Count",
    fill = "Batting Team"
  )
# From this plot, we can
# - Find who played the most balls
# - Identify multi-team players
# - Identify role of the batsman
#   - High count -> anchor player
#   - Low count -> finisher / tail-ender

# Batting team
ggplot(df %>% count(batting_team),
       aes(x = reorder(batting_team, n), y = n, fill = batting_team)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Balls Faced by Each Team",
    x = "Balls",
    y = "Batting Team",
    fill = "Batting Team"
  )
# From this plot, we can
# - Identify which team appears most in the dataset
# - Identify dataset imbalance

# geom_bar() is used to create bar charts
```

```{r}
# Outlier Detection
batsman_df <- df %>%
  group_by(striker) %>%
  summarise(
    total_runs = sum(runs_off_bat),
    balls = n(),
    strike_rate = (total_runs / balls) * 100
  )
```

```{r}
detect_outliers <- function(x) {
  Q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25)
  Q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75)
  IQR <- Q3 - Q1
  
  lower <- Q1 - 1.5 * IQR
  upper <- Q3 + 1.5 * IQR
  
  return(x < lower | x > upper)
}

batsman_df <- batsman_df %>%
  mutate(
    outlier_sr = detect_outliers(strike_rate),
    outlier_runs = detect_outliers(total_runs),
    outlier_balls = detect_outliers(balls)
  )

outliers_df <- batsman_df %>%
  filter(outlier_sr | outlier_runs | outlier_balls)

outliers_df
```

```{r}
# runs_off_bat
ggplot(df, aes(y = runs_off_bat)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "skyblue") +
  ggtitle("Runs per Ball per Batsman")

# strike rate
ggplot(batsman_df, aes(y = strike_rate)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightgreen") +
  ggtitle("Strike Rate per Batsman")

# balls faced
ggplot(batsman_df, aes(y = balls)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "orange") +
  ggtitle("Balls Faced per Batsman")

# total runs
ggplot(batsman_df, aes(y = total_runs)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "pink") +
  ggtitle("Total Runs per Batsman")
```

### One Hot Encoding

#### Venue Grouping

-   Group venues which are very less frequent into a single class "Others"

```{r}
top_venues <- df %>%
  count(venue, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice(1:10) %>%
  pull(venue)
top_venues

df$venue_group <- ifelse(df$venue %in% top_venues, df$venue, "Others")

# One Hot Encoding
venue_encoded <- model.matrix(~ venue_group - 1, data = df)

# Drop original
df <- df %>% select(-venue, -venue_group)

# Combine
df <- cbind(df, venue_encoded)
head(df)
```

```{r}
encoded_df <- model.matrix(
  ~ batting_team + bowling_team + shot_played + shot_direction - 1,
  data = df
)

encoded_df <- as.data.frame(encoded_df)
head(encoded_df)
```

```{r}
# No column to do Label Encoding as there is no column with ordinal values
```

```{r}
str(encoded_df)
```
